narrative.northStar: Forest green and champagne customer account
narrative.overview: Scoped to customer home, Booking, My Bookings, and Profile: a calm, premium account experience grounded in the user's reference and existing assets. Booking and appointments use compact portrait heroes, a 1180px container, a centered 760px wizard, and translucent appointment cards; mobile reduces portrait size and panel padding while retaining bottom navigation space. Profile uses a focused 760px immediately editable name and phone form with avatar/email identification and save/reset actions, without bookings, rewards, or a read-only edit toggle; mobile actions stack. Profile access uses the navigation avatar and home shortcut, with no text Profile link or dock item and a three-column customer dock. Public landing and admin routes remain outside scope, and system behavior stays unchanged.
keyCharacteristics: Centered glass navigation with one gold desktop Book CTA and avatar profile access
Serif headings with mirrored existing portrait
Translucent rewards, wizard, appointment cards, and focused profile editor
dos: Do preserve the existing portrait and real rewards and appointment data.
Do retain visible focus and reduced motion support.
donts: Don't impose this account composition on public landing or admin routes.
